http.lua:
local observed = hangang.geoip()
-- This is address metadata, never an authenticated identity.
hangang.set_header("x-example-country-state", observed.state)
hangang.set_header("x-example-country", observed.country or "unknown")

response_transform.lua:
local observed = hangang.geoip()
local document = hangang.json_decode(hangang.body())
document.gateway_country = observed.country or hangang.null
document.gateway_country_state = observed.state
return hangang.json_encode(document)
